headline: Trump Considers Lifting Sanctions on Russian Sovereign Wealth Fund
summary: Donald Trump is reportedly considering lifting US sanctions imposed on the Russian Direct Investment Fund, a sovereign wealth fund sanctioned following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
why: The Russian Direct Investment Fund manages billions in sovereign assets to facilitate foreign direct investments. Modifying its sanctions status would represent a substantial pivot in US economic policy toward Russia.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Potential sanctions relief would alter Russia's access to international investment channels via its state wealth fund.
